one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-10-14 to 2026-11-13. Q3 2026 results are likely inside it: the Quartr calendar on Bigdata.com lists 2026-11-04, but IonQ had not announced a date by 2026-10-14 (last year it announced on 2025-10-14 for 2025-11-05), so I treat results in the window as very likely, not certain. It is the first quarter with two months of SkyWater; the FY2026 guide is $450-460M and IonQ beat its revenue guidance in recent quarters, while GAAP EPS is swamped by warrant fair-value swings (Polymarket GAAP-EPS beat markets: Yes, Yes, No for the last three quarters; thin volume). Also in the window: settlement of the $2.0B unit offering on ~2026-10-16 (100M new Series C warrants at $69.46; director lock-up 30 days, company 60 days) and possibly the Elisity close (outside date 2027-01-07; regulatory approvals; ~34.8M shares at the $33.07 floor while VWAP stays below it). The stock fell ~9% on 10/14 and ~21% over five days, with QNT -9% on the day: a sector derating plus the offering's value transfer. Short-term reversal and continued negative sector momentum roughly offset, so I centre the 1-month distribution at $31.0 (slightly below spot for the Elisity issuance overhang) with a monthly log-sd of 0.265 (92%/3.5) and no extra skew.

Reverse DCF and EV/sales are weight-0 checks.

methods.name: other
methods.inputs: (a) Milestone rNPV on IonQ's roadmap. Tree: S1 = 256-qubit / 12-logical system demonstrated by end-2027, p 0.75 (roadmap target 2026); S2 = 10,000-physical / 800-logical class machine (roadmap 2027): given S1, by 2029 0.30 / 2030-32 0.30 / never 0.40; given no S1, late 0.15 / never 0.85 -> S2 on time 0.225, late 0.2625, never 0.5125. Outcome given S2 on time: leader 0.45 / contender 0.35 / niche 0.20; given late: 0.15 / 0.40 / 0.45; given never: niche 0.40 / fail 0.60. End states: leader-on-time 0.101, leader-late 0.039, contender 0.184, niche 0.368, fail 0.307. 2035 economics: leader 15% of McKinsey midpoint $57B = $8.55B x 24.3% EBIT (Cisco GAAP) x 0.79 x 20x NOPAT = $32.8B, / 1.16^8.2 (3.377) = $9.72B at the horizon (late: two more years, $7.22B); contender 6% x $57B x 18% x 0.79 x 18x = $8.75B -> $2.59B; niche 1.5% x $43B x 10% x 0.79 x 15x -> $0.23B; fail 0. Less PV of post-horizon development spend including stock comp (~$450M/yr cash burn + ~$400M/yr SBC until breakeven): leader $2.6B, leader-late $3.1B, contender $2.4B, niche $1.2B, fail $0.9B wind-down. Per state, equity = $3,256M net cash + $2,450M units + computing, less the warrant claim solved at that state's price, / 536.4M: $21.99 / $17.10 / $10.51 / $8.50 / $8.63 -> probability-weighted $10.61 (E[computing] = $283M).

inputs_detail.derivation: The 2026 step (100-256+ physical) is already late into 2027 for deliveries (PostQuantum Stage C analysis), and S2 needs a ~40x physical-qubit jump in one year, beyond anything shown by any modality. The small Manifold market (1,000 logical qubits by 2028 ~15%, ~12 traders) points the same way but is too thin to set the number; it is a lead only.

Six Stage C teams: Atom (neutral atoms), Diraq (silicon spin), IBM (superconducting), IonQ (trapped ion), plus Microsoft and PsiQuantum; utility-scale test by 2033. Being on time does not guarantee leadership.
McKinsey Quantum Technology Monitor 2026 as summarised by PostQuantum (the McKinsey page itself was not reachable).
Cisco FY2026 GAAP operating income $15,368M / revenue $63,325M (after SBC), a mature hardware + platform company.
Leader between IBM 17.8x and HON 22.0x NTM P/E, upper half because a 2035 leader would still grow; lower for weaker positions.
Venture-style: 10y UST 5.24% + beta 2.2 x 5% ERP = 16.2%; failure risk sits in the tree, the rate covers financing and execution risk.

bull.story: A 256-qubit system with 12+ logical qubits shown on time, strong Stage C verification news, possibly a U.S. government stake (Polymarket ~10%, thin), and a quantum-sector rebound (QNT and IONQ both ~-61% from highs). Price ~$50, still below the Series C strike.

thesis_break_reason: The horizon floor is net cash $3.26B + operating units $2.45B = $10.64 per share on 536.4M share-equivalents ($10.18 after the warrant claim). At $10.5 the market would price the computing roadmap at about zero or below, i.e. as failed, or would be signalling that the cash or the units are impaired (burn well above ~$550M/yr, write-downs of SkyWater or Elisity, a large cash deal). Fundamental triggers: no 256-qubit / 12-logical system by end-2027, the 10,000-qubit step formally pushed past 2029, or IonQ dropped from DARPA Stage C. Our fair value (~$12.7) is already far below spot, so the break sits under the floor-plus-small-option level, not under spot.

reverse_dcf_check: Today 519.44M share-equivalents (incl. the 2026-10-14 offering, Elisity at the floor, earnout, retention RSUs and existing awards) x $31.545 = $16.4B, plus ~$2.2B of warrant value at spot, less $3.81B net cash and $2.45B of operating units leaves ~$12.4B for computing. At 16% with $2.6B of further spend that needs ~$57B of 2035 computing EV, i.e. ~$14.9B revenue at Cisco's 24.3% GAAP margin and 20x NOPAT: 26% of McKinsey's $57B 2035 midpoint (21% of the $71B high) with certainty. Our tree gives a 15% share a ~0.14 probability and a 33% chance another modality wins, so the price embeds near-certain leadership. The engine's multiples have weight 0, so its implied WACC is not informative. This is why fair value ($12.67) sits ~60% below spot.

reasoning: Round 2. Facts verified at source: the 424B5 (408.9M shares on 2026-10-13; 20.5M shares + 29.5M pre-funded warrants + 100M Series C @ $69.46 to 2033; ~$1,988.5M net; 17.05M RSUs, 3.95M PSUs, 1.84M options at 6/30), the Elisity 8-K ($1,150M in stock, $33.07-$49.61 collar, $150M earnout, $100M retention RSUs), the Q2 release ($2.0B pro forma cash; adj. EBITDA -$120.3M; ~60% commercial), SkyWater's 10-Q, QNT's 10-Q and quote, R57 deal prices, the roadmap, DARPA's Stage C page and McKinsey 2026 via PostQuantum. Adopted the supervisor's share build (536.4M at the horizon, which adds the ~20.5M existing awards and Elisity RSUs I had missed) and cash bridge ($3.81B now, $3.26B at the horizon). Units cut from $3.74B to $2.45B: the SkyWater 38% premium was trade press only and is dropped, and units are valued on GFS/ZS/OKTA, not at cost. Post-horizon SBC is now inside development spend. The FMP consensus DCF leg is dropped (consensus not verifiable at a named page). Computing: rNPV ~$0.3B, TAM ~$0.6B, option $1.1B, cost $1.9B, QNT mark $5.5B; market implies ~$12.4B. Fair value $12.67 (methods $10.61-$19.29). Alternative-lane evidence: DARPA Stage C (QCR, PostQuantum, HN lead) is the main positive; deliveries of the 256-qubit system have moved to 2027 (PostQuantum); hiring keeps rising (LinkUp 167 active jobs Sep-26 vs 67, Greenhouse 131), meaning more burn; developer pull weak (qiskit-ionq downloads ~53K Sep-26 vs ~110K Apr-26); Stocktwits sentiment bearish on Elisity; USAspending shows small DoD prime awards (IonQ $13.4M, Vector Atomic $59.7M, Capella $13.0M), so government revenue flows through other vehicles or agencies. Prediction markets (Manifold, Polymarket) are thin and now only corroborate, never set, a probability. Defense: ~60% commercial per the Q2 release and CFO, so U.S. government is at most ~40% of IonQ revenue; the defense/intelligence subset is undisclosed; SkyWater's ATS (40% of its Q2-26 revenue) adds aerospace/defense exposure. Distribution: fundamentals point far below spot, but this name trades on sentiment and a 92%-vol lognormal alone puts the median near $21. Mixture bear $12.5 (0.35) / base $22.5 (0.45) / bull $50 (0.20), within-scenario log-sd 0.32/0.35/0.42: median ~$20.2, mean ~$26.3, P(>= $31.545) ~0.25. Research was limited: Benzinga (403), Reddit, X and McKinsey's own page unreachable.
